description: This file implements a data structure ('subs_vector_t') and associated functions for managing a dynamic collection of subscription objects ('subs_t'). It provides initialization, addition, removal, destruction, and garbage collection of subscriptions, as well as logging and retrieval functions, indicating it is core logic for handling subscription data in the software project.

methods.name: void SUBS_VECTOR_Init(subs_vector_t * suv)
methods.description: Initializes a subscription vector by setting its internal pointer to NULL and entry count to zero.

methods.name: void SUBS_VECTOR_Add(subs_vector_t * suv,subs_t * sub)
methods.description: Adds a subscription to the vector, reallocating memory as needed without deep copying.

methods.name: void SUBS_VECTOR_Remove(subs_vector_t * suv,subs_t * sub)
methods.description: Marks a subscription for deletion and performs garbage collection.

methods.name: void SUBS_VECTOR_Destroy(subs_vector_t * suv)
methods.description: Frees all memory associated with the subscription vector and resets it.

methods.name: void SUBS_VECTOR_DestroySubscriber(subs_t * sub)
methods.description: Frees all dynamically allocated memory within a subscription object.

methods.name: subs_t * SUBS_VECTOR_GetSubsByInstance(subs_vector_t * suv,int instance)
methods.description: Retrieves a subscription by its instance number.

methods.name: void SUBS_VECTOR_MarkSubscriptionForDeletion(subs_t * sub)
methods.description: Destroys a subscription's internal resources and marks it as invalid for deletion.

methods.name: void SUBS_VECTOR_GarbageCollectSubscriptions(subs_vector_t * suv)
methods.description: Removes subscriptions marked as invalid from the vector and compacts the array.

methods.name: void SUBS_VECTOR_Dump(subs_vector_t * suv)
methods.description: Logs all active subscriptions in the vector for debugging purposes.
